verdict.rationale: turbopuffer's own docs clearly cover approximate nearest-neighbor search over embeddings. It uses an incrementally built SPFresh vector index, auto-tuned for 90-100% recall, with a recall endpoint for self-testing, and adds exact kNN, dense/sparse vectors and filtered search. However, nothing in the pack shows that distance metrics (e.g., cosine vs. Euclidean vs. dot product) can be configured, and that is an explicit half of the story. Missing for 10: documented configurable distance metrics, independent or hands-on corroboration of ANN quality and performance.
